svg.aria-label: Animation: a feature from a map to a merged task. You type /quorum:map with the idea: you name the destination, and it charts 6 decision tickets; two research tickets start at once. Then /quorum:map with the map's slug, one ticket per session: a researcher gathers the code facts, you decide, and the Feasibility Critic checks each decision. With nothing left to decide, it writes tasks.md with 3 slices, reviewed in map mode, and you approve it. Then /quorum:run --map: task 1's spec comes from the map's decisions; you approve the reviewed plan; the builder writes tests first; review round 1 sends an unescaped CSV field back to the builder, and round 2 converges; the blind test passes; the proof passes and the PR is drafted, and once you merge it, task 2 is ready.
svg.text: A feature: chart it, research it, build it
> /quorum:map Let regional managers run their own weekly reports
Step 1 of 12: You name the destination; it grills breadth-first and charts 6 decision tickets
Step 2 of 12: Two research tickets start at once: researchers check the docs for the pinned versions
Step 3 of 12: One ticket per session: a researcher gathers the code facts, then you decide
Step 4 of 12: The Feasibility Critic checks each decision against the code before it's recorded
Step 5 of 12: Nothing left to decide: tasks.md, 3 slices, reviewed in map mode; you approve it
Step 6 of 12: Task 1's spec comes from the map's decisions: nothing decided is asked again
Step 7 of 12: The plan is reviewed before any code exists; you approve it
Step 8 of 12: The builder writes each test first, with the checks locked
Step 9 of 12: Round 1: the reviewers find an unescaped CSV field, and the voter keeps it
Step 10 of 12: Round 2 converges: nothing IMPORTANT left
Step 11 of 12: A first-time user reaches the goal through the CLI, with no source access
Step 12 of 12: The proof passes at HEAD and the PR is drafted; you merge it, and task 2 is ready
Teal: it ran and passed · Amber: it stopped for you · Red: a check sent the work back
